title: Application of the Hierarchical Bootstrap to Multi-Level Data in Neuroscience
mechanism: Resample the top level (subjects) then the lower level (trials) to get correct CIs on nested data.
adaptation: Resample modules then cells for E1 (106 cells from 67 modules) and the OOF pool, where cells from one module are correlated.
min_experiment: Arm: module-then-cell bootstrap. Baseline: cell bootstrap. Metric: CI width. Kill: module CI < 10% wider.
evidence: R: simulations and neuroscience data show flat bootstrap underestimates uncertainty on multi-level data.
